title: VMware vSphere / VCF - ESX hosts
description: Selected ESX host(s): status, CPU / memory, storage, network, hardware, VMs (click a VM to open it).

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name, version, build, model) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_connection_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_in_maintenance{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) ((vmware_host_cpu_usage_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"} / vmware_host_cpu_total_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"}))

max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) ((vmware_host_memory_usage_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"} / vmware_host_memory_total_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"}))
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_vms{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_uptime_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_reboot_required{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_config_issues{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_power_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_quarantine_mode{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_certificate_expiry_timestamp_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"} - time())

max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (count by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_alarm_triggered{vcenter=~"$vcenter", entity_type="HostSystem"} * on(vcenter, entity) group_left(cluster_name, host_name) label_replace(vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"}, "entity", "$1", "host_name", "(.*)")))
max by (vcenter, host_name, vendor, model, cpu_model, bios_version, product) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, host_name) (vmware_host_cpu_cores{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, host_name) (vmware_host_cpu_threads{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, host_name) (vmware_host_cpu_total_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, host_name) (vmware_host_memory_total_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, host_name) (vmware_host_datastores{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, host_name) (vmware_host_storage_luns{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

(vmware_host_cpu_usage_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"} / vmware_host_cpu_total_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
vmware_host_perf_cpu_utilization_average_percent{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""} / 100
vmware_host_perf_cpu_core_utilization_average_percent{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""} / 100

(vmware_host_memory_usage_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"} / vmware_host_memory_total_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
vmware_host_perf_mem_usage_average_percent{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""} / 100
vmware_host_perf_mem_consumed_average_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_mem_active_average_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_mem_vmmemctl_average_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}

panels.title: Hypervisor swap rate
panels.description: Should stay at 0: host memory overcommitment.

targets.expr: vmware_host_perf_mem_swapin_rate_average_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_mem_swapout_rate_average_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_disk_read_average_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_disk_write_average_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
max by (vcenter, host_name) (vmware_host_perf_disk_max_total_latency_latest_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

panels.title: Datastore latency seen by the host (max of read / write)
panels.description: Per datastore (datastore.totalRead/WriteLatency counters, instance = datastore UUID resolved to its name).

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, host_name, perf_instance) ({__name__=~"vmware_host_perf_datastore_total_(read|write)_latency_average_seconds", vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance!=""}) * on(vcenter, perf_instance) group_left(ds_name) max by (vcenter, perf_instance, ds_name) (label_replace(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", url=~".*/volumes/.+"}, "perf_instance", "$1", "url", ".*/volumes/([^/]+)/?"))

max by (vcenter, host_name, perf_instance) ({__name__=~"vmware_host_perf_datastore_total_(read|write)_latency_average_seconds", vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance!=""}) unless on(vcenter, perf_instance) max by (vcenter, perf_instance, ds_name) (label_replace(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", url=~".*/volumes/.+"}, "perf_instance", "$1", "url", ".*/volumes/([^/]+)/?"))
sum by (vcenter, host_name, state) (vmware_host_storage_paths{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
vmware_host_storage_luns_degraded{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"}
vmware_host_storage_luns_no_path{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"}

panels.title: Datastores of the host's datacenter
panels.description: Datastores of the datacenter(s) containing the selected host(s) (the exporter does not expose the host/datastore mount map).

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name, type, shared) (vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) (vmware_datastore_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) (vmware_datastore_is_accessible{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) (vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) (vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) (1 - vmware_datastore_free_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} / vmware_datastore_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) (vmware_datastore_hosts_mounted{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, ds_name) (vmware_datastore_hosts_inaccessible{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, dc_name) (vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
vmware_host_perf_net_received_average_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_net_transmitted_average_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_net_dropped_rx_summation{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_net_dropped_tx_summation{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_net_errors_rx_summation{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_perf_net_errors_tx_summation{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
max by (vcenter, host_name, nic, driver, used) (vmware_host_pnic_link_up{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, host_name, nic) (vmware_host_pnic_link_up{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (vcenter, host_name, nic) (vmware_host_pnic_speed_mbps{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"} * 1000000)
vmware_host_perf_power_power_average_watts{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name", perf_instance=""}
vmware_host_hardware_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"}
max by (host_name, type, sensor) (vmware_host_sensor_health{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (host_name, type, sensor, unit) (vmware_host_sensor_value{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
max by (host_name, type, sensor) (vmware_host_sensor_value{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})
vmware_host_service_running{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"}

panels.title: VMs (click a VM to open it)

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid, host_name, cluster_name, guest_os, ip_address) (vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_power_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_vcpus{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_memory_size_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_cpu_usage_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (((vmware_vm_perf_cpu_ready_summation_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", perf_instance=""} / 20) / ignoring(perf_instance) vmware_vm_vcpus{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_memory_host_consumed_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_tools_running{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_snapshots_existing{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

max by (vcenter, vm_name, vm_moid) (vmware_vm_uptime_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by CPU ready (% per vCPU)

targets.expr: topk(10, ((vmware_vm_perf_cpu_ready_summation_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", perf_instance=""} / 20) / ignoring(perf_instance) vmware_vm_vcpus{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

topk(10, vmware_vm_cpu_usage_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"})

panels.title: Active alarms on the host
panels.description: Active (triggered) vCenter alarms. Only present when an alarm is active.

targets.expr: vmware_alarm_triggered{vcenter=~"$vcenter", entity_type="HostSystem"} and on(vcenter, entity) label_replace(vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", host_name=~"$host_name"}, "entity", "$1", "host_name", "(.*)")
